subject: Request: Trial grace period due to integration lag
messages:
From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lumenfit.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jamie Ortiz <jamie.ortiz@lumenfit.io>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Need extra time on trial — integration lag

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week — the team is excited by the latency numbers but we've hit a blocker during the sandbox integration. The vendor staging environment returned an unexpected schema for our user metadata, and our engineering team needs to update the ingestion mapping.

Current situation: the trial sandbox is provisioned and we've run a few end-to-end tests, but we consumed ~85% of our trial quota while debugging (unexpected token churn in the preprocessor). We need another 10–14 days to finish the fix and re-run a full pilot.

Could Redwood extend the trial window or provide a short grace period/top-up so we can complete the integration without losing momentum? I attached the integration logs and a short note from our engineer.

Attachments: lumenfit-integration-logs.zip (zip), integration-checklist.xlsx (xlsx)

We appreciate any help — hoping to move to a POC contract shortly after.

Best,
Alex
Head of Data Engineering
LumenFit
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@lumenfit.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Need extra time on trial — integration lag

Hi Alex — thanks for the quick summary and for sending the logs. Sorry to hear about the schema mismatch; that's the kind of integration snag we expect on pilots.

Quick note on next steps: I can escalate a short grace period to our trials team and request a token top-up. To move fast, I need:
- confirmation of the exact extra days you need (10 or 14)
- a short success criterion (e.g., ingest + 3 production-like requests with <200ms median latency)
- an estimate of any additional quota required (approx tokens).

I copied Marissa (Customer Success) to monitor the pilot and keep an eye on usage, and we'll loop in Aditya for pricing/approval if there's a promotional credit ask.

If you can reply with the above by end of day, I'll push this through.

Thanks — Neha
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 08:34:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Need extra time on trial — LumenFit (requesting grace/top-up)

Team — forwarding LumenFit's ask. TL;DR: integration staging returned a schema mismatch; they've consumed ~85% of trial tokens while debugging. Customer requests a 10–14 day extension (they lean 10 days) and ~15k additional tokens to finish a production-like run.

Dylan — can you confirm whether we can offer a short-term quota top-up without impacting billing rules? Is there any short-term technical workaround (e.g., swapping to a smaller context or using prefix caching) that reduces token burn while they finish the mapping?

Marissa — please monitor usage and let me know if we should enable tighter rate limits on their account while the top-up is active.

Aditya — do we have precedent to approve a 10-day trial grace + 15k token promo for a mid-market pilot? If you approve, I will send confirmation to Alex and attach the revised trial terms.

Regards,
Neha
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Alex Chen <alex.chen@lumenfit.io>
Date: Wed, 6 May 2026 14:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Need extra time on trial — LumenFit (requesting grace/top-up)

Neha / team / Alex — thanks for the details. Approve a 10-calendar-day trial grace period and a one-time 15,000-token promotional top-up. Conditions:
- Marissa to monitor usage and flag if they exceed the top-up before the 10 days end.
- Dylan, please enable prefix caching suggestion in the interim (reduce tokenized context where possible).
- Neha, send an updated trial terms PDF (redwood-trial-terms.pdf) that notes the extension and the top-up; include a short note that additional credits beyond this will require a paid commitment.

Alex — happy to keep you moving. Neha will send formal confirmation and the updated trial terms. Let me know if you need anything else to keep the pilot on schedule.

- Aditya
SVP, Sales | Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.ai
